'''Sofu''' (Japanese: '''ソフウ'''  ''Sofū'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}, who first appeared in ''[[SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!]]''. He is the late grandfather of [[Hapu]] and a former [[island kahuna]] of [[Poni Island]].

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|SM}}====
Sofu debuted in ''[[SM107|Run, Heroes, Run!]]'', where {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Fini}} summoned his spirit from the dead to oversee a [[Island challenge|trial]] it had set up for {{an|Kiawe}}. After the trial was over, he observed Kiawe and {{Ash}} alongside the ghost of [[Kiawe's grandfather]], before the both of them faded away.

He appeared again in ''[[SM108|Memories in the Mist!]]'', where he reunited with his granddaughter in the [[Ruins of Hope]]. There, he informed her that Tapu Fini had accepted her as the new Poni Island Kahuna before Tapu Fini cleared the mist and faded away again.

==In the core series games==
===Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon===
Hapu mentioned her late grandfather as the former [[island kahuna]] of [[Poni Island]]. She was later chosen by {{p|Tapu Fini}} to succeeded him as the island kahuna.
